name: Talking Heads

whyMatters.en: CBGB-origin art-funk band; Remain in Light (1980, Eno) fused polyrhythm, looped guitar, and Byrne’s vocal into new-wave’s densest studio peak.
whyMatters.zh: 源自 CBGB 的 art-funk；Remain in Light（1980，Eno）把复合节奏、循环吉他与 Byrne 人声做成 new wave 最密的录音室高峰。

essentialTracks.title: This Must Be the Place (Naive Melody)

note.en: Nervous funk trio grammar before Harrison; bass ostinato + dry drums.
note.zh: Harrison 前的紧张 funk 三人语法；贝斯固定音型 + 干鼓。

note.en: Eno-era polyrhythm, looped parts, Byrne spoken-sung hook.
note.zh: Eno 时期复合节奏、循环声部、Byrne 说唱钩子。

note.en: Speaking in Tongues hit; expanded live band, MTV-scale chorus.
note.zh: Speaking in Tongues 热单；扩编现场乐队、MTV 尺度副歌。

interviewQuotes.speaker: David Byrne
interviewQuotes.source: Once in a Lifetime lyric · quote wall

interviewQuotes.text: We wanted to make music you could dance to without looking stupid.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Tina Weymouth

lyricQuotes: And you may find yourself living in a shotgun shack

shortBio.en: Byrne / Harrison / Weymouth / Frantz new wave; Once in a Lifetime is the mass entry.
shortBio.zh: Byrne / Harrison / Weymouth / Frantz 的 new wave；Once in a Lifetime 是大众入口。

body.en:
Formed 1975. Talking Heads: 77 and More Songs… established nervous funk; Fear of Music and Remain in Light expanded African/American rhythm collaboration and studio layering.

Once in a Lifetime (1980) is the listed track. They show post-punk can be dance music and art school without glam costume—groove and lyric dissociation as method.
body.zh:
1975 年组建。Talking Heads: 77 与 More Songs… 确立紧张 funk；Fear of Music 与 Remain in Light 扩展非裔/美洲节奏合作与录音室分层。

Once in a Lifetime（1980）是列出曲目。证明后朋克可以是舞曲与艺术学院产物而无 glam 戏服——groove 与歌词抽离即方法。

title.zh: Art-funk 进入 new-wave 录音室密度

body.en:
CBGB tightness plus Weymouth/Frantz groove becomes Remain in Light’s looped polyrhythm with Eno.

New wave’s densest studio peak without abandoning dance grid.
body.zh:
CBGB 紧凑加上 Weymouth/Frantz groove，经 Eno 变成 Remain in Light 的循环复合节奏。

new wave 最密录音室高峰，不丢舞曲格子。

title.zh: CBGB 三人 → 四人 + Eno 时期

body.en:
Early Heads: Byrne/Weymouth/Frantz. Harrison joins 1977. Remain in Light adds session players in studio while logo stays four.

Versions are production states more than singer swaps.
body.zh:
早期 Heads：Byrne/Weymouth/Frantz。Harrison 1977 加入。Remain in Light 录音室加 session，logo 仍四人。

版本是制作状态多于换主唱。

title.en: Once in a Lifetime: loop as hook
title.zh: Once in a Lifetime：循环即钩子

body.en:
Spoken-sung verses over interlocking bass/guitar/keys. MTV video locks the water-gesture stage grammar.

Teaching track for Remain in Light method.
body.zh:
互锁贝斯/吉他/键盘上的说唱主歌。MTV 录像锁死泼水手势舞台语法。

Remain in Light 方法教材曲。

body.en:
Byrne’s angular guitar and nervous baritone sit on Weymouth’s melodic funk bass and Frantz’s dry kick. Harrison adds keys/guitar color.

Tom Tom Club (Weymouth/Frantz) proves the rhythm section can own a separate hit logo.
body.zh:
Byrne 棱角吉他与紧张男中音坐在 Weymouth 旋律 funk 贝斯与 Frantz 干底鼓上。Harrison 加键盘/吉他色彩。

Tom Tom Club（Weymouth/Frantz）证明节奏组可拥有独立热单 logo。

body.en:
Weymouth’s dance claim and Byrne’s lyric catchphrase document the Heads bargain: art posture plus floor utility.

Quotes are method labels.
body.zh:
Weymouth 的舞曲主张与 Byrne 歌词口头禅记录 Heads 交易：艺术姿态 + 舞池效用。

引语是方法标签。

title.en: Post-punk as dance and studio system
title.zh: 后朋克作为舞曲与录音室系统

body.en:
Radiohead and later art-rock cite Remain in Light density. Depeche Mode and new-wave peers share the dance-grid inheritance.

Heads prove CBGB can scale to polyrhythm albums.
body.zh:
Radiohead 与后来 art-rock 引用 Remain in Light 密度。Depeche Mode 与 new-wave 同辈共享舞曲格子遗产。

Heads 证明 CBGB 可扩到复合节奏专辑。

note.en: Remain in Light through Speaking in Tongues peak years.
note.zh: Remain in Light 至 Speaking in Tongues 峰值年。

note.en: Eno-era polyrhythm as new-wave mass entry.
note.zh: Eno 时期复合节奏作为 new-wave 大众入口。

note.en: Art-school funk + studio looping without glam costume.
note.zh: 艺术学院 funk + 录音室循环，无 glam 戏服。
